name: skeletons
title: Skeletons
description: Minimal Tailwind loading placeholders for text and circular content.
useWhen: Content will arrive shortly and reserving its space prevents layout shift.
avoidWhen: The wait is long enough to need meaningful progress or error feedback.
responsiveBehavior: Placeholders flex only when the consumer supplies a width override.
accessibility: Skeletons are hidden from assistive technology because they are not content.
Pair loading UI with an accessible loading announcement where needed.

variants.title: Text line
variants.description: A short rounded line for reserving the place of a sentence, label, or metadata value.
accessibility: Hide the placeholder itself from assistive technology.

variants.title: Circle placeholder
variants.description: A circular placeholder for an avatar, icon, or compact graphic while its content loads.
accessibility: Hide the placeholder itself from assistive technology.
